method: Downloaded every cluster.idx for the 23 Common Crawl collections spanning 2008-2009 through 2015-48. For each SURT prefix, selected both bounding CDX gzip blocks by binary search, fetched each exact byte range from data.commoncrawl.org, verified the returned byte count, decompressed the independent gzip member, parsed every CDXJ row, and matched by SURT-key prefix.
whyThisWindow: This covers the complete high-value interval when the 2008-2009 assets existed and extends through 2015, after ImageShack mass deletion in 2014 and after skhaz.com became non-editorial.
acceptanceRule: A hit would still require range-fetching the referenced ARC/WARC record and validating response status, payload signature, MIME, dimensions and SHA-256. No CDXJ locator was found, so no image or ZIP payload was available to validate.
